description: Parameters of the engine whose uncertainty is known from the literature, for uncertainty.py. ratios: a ratio with a 95% confidence interval, drawn from a log-normal distribution around the value of the configuration. shares: a share that was observed as events among patients, drawn from a beta distribution. regimen_patients: number of treated patients behind the rates of a regimen; every rate of the regimen is drawn from a beta distribution of that size. Parameters without a published interval keep their value, so the intervals of the results show only a part of the uncertainty.

Lung toxicity recognised late
shares.basis: Swain et al. (2022): 71 of 148 events with an earlier onset by the committee; the value of the configuration, 53%, is the one of Powell et al. (2022)

regimen_patients.basis: safety populations of NAPOLI 3 (Wainberg et al., 2023), VISION (Sartor et al., 2021), PROfound (de Bono et al., 2020), DESTINY-Breast04 (Modi et al., 2022) and ASCENT (Bardia et al., 2021). The rates of the other regimens keep their value.

cardiovascular_rate_patients.basis: leuprolide arm of HERO (Shore et al., 2020), 19 events among 308 men
